bosses.name: Gorrak the Wall
bosses.title: Ogre Warlord
bosses.rule: Shieldwall: your shooters cannot shoot.
bosses.look: a hulking grey-skinned ogre in riveted iron plate behind a tower shield as tall as a door

bosses.name: Sorceress Ilvane
bosses.title: Warlock of Dungeon
bosses.rule: Silence: your hero cannot cast spells.
bosses.look: a pale dark-elf sorceress with a finger to her lips, violet runes sealing a floating spellbook

bosses.name: Windcaller Aelis
bosses.title: Druid of Sylvan
bosses.rule: Gale: your fliers are grounded.
bosses.look: a young elven druid in green robes, hair whipped by a gale, staff wrapped in swirling leaves

bosses.name: Skrag the Goblin King
bosses.title: Lord of the Warrens
bosses.rule: Swarm: his tier 1–2 stacks are half again as large.
bosses.look: a scrawny grinning goblin on a throne of junk, oversized dented crown, a crowd of goblins behind

bosses.name: Fenra Wolfmother
bosses.title: Huntress of the Wilds
bosses.rule: Pack Hunt: her stacks deal ×1.3 to a stack already struck this round.
bosses.look: a wild-haired huntress in a wolf-pelt hood, bone spear, a great grey wolf at her side

bosses.name: Captain Odric Vale
bosses.title: Pikemaster of Haven
bosses.rule: Phalanx: his stacks +4 Defence, and his first-slot stack takes −50% damage.
bosses.look: a grizzled human captain in blue-and-silver plate, a long pike planted, a wall of shields behind

bosses.name: Mordecai Bonetide
bosses.title: Gravelord of Necropolis
bosses.rule: Grave Chill: your stacks −1 speed and −1 Attack.
bosses.look: a gaunt necromancer in tattered black robes, lantern of green soul-fire, skeleton hands rising from the ground

bosses.name: Malphas the Plaguebringer
bosses.title: Pit Lord of Inferno
bosses.rule: Plague: your first stack starts the battle with 30% fewer creatures.
bosses.look: a horned pit lord wreathed in sickly green smoke, a rusted scythe, flies around him

bosses.name: Krug the Endless
bosses.title: Troll Chieftain
bosses.rule: Regeneration: his stacks heal fully every round.
bosses.look: a towering green troll chieftain with a tree-trunk club, wounds visibly closing, tusks and war paint

bosses.name: Khazrak Hellrider
bosses.title: Demon Knight
bosses.rule: Stampede: his stacks +3 speed.
bosses.look: a demon knight in black spiked armour astride a flaming nightmare steed, mid-charge

bosses.name: Sir Brannoc Ironhide
bosses.title: Fallen Paladin
bosses.rule: Ironhide: his stacks take −50% damage from your shots.
bosses.look: a fallen paladin in scarred plate, cracked holy symbol on his breastplate, arrows broken against it

bosses.name: Ashka the Emberwitch
bosses.title: Pyromancer of Inferno
bosses.rule: Firestorm: at the start of rounds 2, 4 and 6, fire burns each of your stacks for 6% of its hit points.
bosses.look: a red-skinned witch with smouldering hair and ember eyes, a ring of fire in her raised palms

bosses.name: Lysara Thornqueen
bosses.title: Warden of the Briars
bosses.rule: Entangling Roots: your walkers have speed 1 in rounds 1 and 2.
bosses.look: a regal dryad crowned with thorned roses, bark-skinned arms, vines coiling from the ground

bosses.name: Xyloth the Many-Eyed
bosses.title: Beholder Overseer
bosses.rule: Petrifying Gaze: at the start of every round one of your stacks turns to stone and loses its turn.
bosses.look: a huge floating beholder with one great central eye and a crown of eyestalks, stony light from its gaze

bosses.name: Grumm One-Eye
bosses.title: Cyclops Warlord
bosses.rule: Boulders: his shooters throw twice per turn.
bosses.look: a one-eyed cyclops warlord hefting a boulder overhead, rope belt of skulls, crude iron crown

bosses.name: Vesperine, the Lich Queen
bosses.title: Necromancer of the Last Crown
bosses.rule: Lifedrinker: her stacks heal half the damage they deal and raise their dead.
bosses.look: a skeletal queen in a tall black-iron crown and violet gown, glowing eye-sockets, a staff topped with a soul gem

bosses.name: Shadowmother Zyra
bosses.title: Dungeon Overlord
bosses.rule: Eclipse: your hero's Attack and Defence count as 0.
bosses.look: a dark-elf matriarch in obsidian armour before a black sun, shadow tendrils spreading behind her

bosses.name: Asterion the Labyrinth King
bosses.title: Minotaur Warlord
bosses.rule: Bloodrage: his stacks gain +1 Attack every time they are struck (up to +10).
bosses.look: a massive minotaur king with a gold-ringed horn, double-headed labrys, a stone labyrinth behind

bosses.name: Ssylith Hydra-Mother
bosses.title: Mistress of the Mire
bosses.rule: Many Heads: her stacks retaliate twice, at ×1.5 damage.
bosses.look: a serpent-bodied naga queen coiled in a swamp, three hydra heads rising behind her

bosses.name: Elder Thalion Stormcaller
bosses.title: Archdruid of Sylvan
bosses.rule: Chain Lightning: at the start of every round lightning strikes your two largest stacks for 8% of their hit points.
bosses.look: an ancient elf archdruid with a white beard braided with leaves, lightning arcing from an oak staff, storm clouds

bosses.name: Vyrmathra the Dragonmother
bosses.title: Mythic · Queen of All Dragons
bosses.rule: Dragonmother: her stacks are immune to your spells, and her tier 7 creatures +50% hit points.
bosses.look: a colossal ancient dragon with scales shifting through green, gold, red and black, wings spread over a hoard

bosses.name: Baal'zareth the Unbound
bosses.title: Mythic · Archdevil of the Pit
bosses.rule: Hellgate: at the start of every round his weakest stack is restored to full strength.
bosses.look: a towering archdevil with curling ram horns and burning wings, a gate of hellfire opening behind him

bosses.name: Seraphine the Fallen
bosses.title: Mythic · Archangel Unbound
bosses.rule: Divine Wrath: your hero cannot cast spells, and her stacks heal fully every round.
bosses.look: a fallen archangel with tarnished gold armour and wings half white, half ash-grey, a flaming sword lowered

bosses.name: Morvane the Dread King
bosses.title: Mythic · Lord of the Endless Night
bosses.rule: Dread: from round 2, your stacks lose 8% of their creatures at the start of every round.
bosses.look: a spectral king in rusted black plate on a ghostly throne, a crown of cold blue fire, mist pouring from his cloak
